completed_steps.summary: Classified as monorepo (melos + pub workspace) with 6 parts: app (mobile) + 5 libraries. Layer rule presentation->application->domain<-data confirmed from pubspec dependency graph.

Existing docs inventoried: README.md, CONTRACTS.md (283 lines, binding rules), .github/SECRETS.md, design-artifacts/ (A-E WDS stages), _bmad-output/planning-artifacts/research (1 market research file). docs/ was empty.

Tech stack extracted from 7 pubspec.yaml files: Flutter 3.41.7 / Dart 3.11.5, Melos 7.5.1, Riverpod 3.0.3, Drift 2.26 + SQLCipher, go_router 14.6, fl_chart 0.68, Firebase Analytics, purchases_flutter 10 (uncommitted).

Deep scan per part. domain: read all entities/enums/logic/repositories/value_objects. data: read tables, app_database (schemaVersion 5, 4 migration steps, SQLCipher key mgmt), DAOs, mappers, repositories. application: read all 14 provider files, ports, entitlement/purchase, use cases. design_system: tokens, SC semantic layer, theme, l10n.yaml (7 arb x 230 keys). presentation: router, 8 screens, ~20 widgets; measured 287 AppColors vs 38 SC refs (CONTRACTS 4.1 violation). app: main.dart DI wiring, revenuecat_service/config, Makefile, both GH workflows.
source-tree-analysis.md written: annotated tree, 9 entry points, critical-directory lookup table.
Dev/deploy info extracted from Makefile (40+ targets), melos.yaml scripts, ci.yml, cd.yml, .github/SECRETS.md. No CONTRIBUTING.md found; CONTRACTS.md fills that role.
integration-architecture.md written: 6 integration points, DI port table, reactive Drift->provider->UI loop, cross-cutting concerns.
6 per-part architecture docs written (domain, data, application, design_system, presentation, app).
Supporting docs written: project-overview, api-contracts-domain, data-models-data, 2 component inventories, development-guide, deployment-guide.
index.md written with per-part navigation, existing-doc inventory, getting started, and explicit not-applicable notes (contribution guide, non-UI component inventories, network API).

Validation pass against checklist.md. Corrections applied after verifying claims that had rested on truncated reads: (1) read CONTRACTS.md lines 120-283 (sections 4.3-10, previously unread) and folded 4.3/4.4/4.5, 5.1-5.3, 6.1-6.4, 7.1-7.3, 8.1-8.3, 9.1-9.3, 10 into the relevant docs; (2) verified all 7 arb files carry exactly 230 keys (parity holds); (3) confirmed no font size above 42 exists in app_text_styles.dart, so the 72px hero of 4.2 is genuinely untokenized; (4) discovered melos.yaml is dead config -- melos resolves scripts from the root pubspec.yaml melos block (test/analyze/gen only), so test:all and test:integration:* do not exist; corrected 4 docs. Added project-parts.json (checklist requires it for multi-part). Link-integrity check over all 17 md files: no broken internal links.

findings.technology_stack: Flutter 3.41.7 + Riverpod + Drift/SQLCipher, offline-only, no backend
known_gaps: CONTRACTS 4.1/4.4 color contract: 287 raw AppColors refs vs 38 SC refs in presentation
CONTRACTS 5.1 declares schema version 4; the code is at 5 (transactions.category)
CONTRACTS 3.4/5.3 say investment is excluded from burn rate, but in code it lands in grossOutflow and does feed burn
CONTRACTS 3.3 investable/safety-fund model specified but not implemented in domain/lib/logic
CONTRACTS 4.2 specifies a 72px hero; no style above 42px exists in app_text_styles.dart
melos.yaml is dead config: melos reads scripts from the root pubspec.yaml melos block (test/analyze/gen only), so test:all and test:integration:* do not exist
design_system and presentation have zero tests; CI runs domain suite only, so data and application tests never run in CI
CONTRACTS 6.3 forbids hardcoded user-facing strings; app_router.dart action sheet uses literal ENTRY/LOAN/SUBSCRIPTIONS
iOS bundle id com.silverfern.survivaloptimizer vs Android applicationId com.survival.app; make db-reset-android targets wrong package
app_input_formatters.dart duplicated in components/ and utils/
no Drift migration verification tests; make l10n-check validates arb JSON but not key-set parity
kRevenueCatGoogleKey is a placeholder, so isRevenueCatConfigured is false and purchases are disabled on both platforms
findings.verification_performed: Link-integrity check across all 17 markdown files (no broken internal links); JSON validity of both report files; arb key-count parity across all 7 locales (230 each); melos script resolution confirmed empirically via `melos run`. NOT run: flutter analyze, any test suite, any build.
